summary: Font/event render dispatch prepper. Resolves a generation index and two sub-indices from *a1 via three helper lookups, returning 0 on any sentinel (-1) or negative result. A one-time init block (guarded by byte_5EA5E0 bit 0) resets the track-load state block and sentinels. Every call re-primes the path buffer through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and dispatches in sequence through CharacterCodeMapper, RaceEventMessageDispatcher, FontCharacterRenderDispatcher and SoundEventDispatcher, advancing a 20-byte slot offset per successful dispatch and decrementing counters. Returns the count of successful dispatches (0-2). Called by TextOverlayDisplayTimer (004186F0).

local_names.a1: input descriptor array whose first dword carries the text/overlay generation parameter
local_names.a2: output slot base address, advanced by 20 bytes per dispatch success

operations.description: Resolve generation: v5 = ShortComputation_19d0(*a1); return 0 when it equals -1
Resolve sub-indices: v9 = ShortComputation_1a00(*a1, v5) and v8 = ShortComputation_1a50(*a1); return 0 when either is negative

One-time initialization when byte_5EA5E0 bit 0 is clear: set bit 0, dword_5EA5D0 = 0, dword_5EA5D4 = -1, StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(&byte_5EA438), dword_5EA5D8 = -1, dword_5EA5DC = -1, then BooleanToIntConversion(sub_4119B0)
Per-call re-prime: StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(&byte_5EA438) then reset dword_5EA5D8 = -1 and dword_5EA5DC = -1
CharacterCodeMapper(v9 + v8, v5, &dword_5EA5D0, *a1): on nonzero return 0
RaceEventMessageDispatcher(v5, &dword_5EA5D0, a1, a2) == 1 triggers DecrementCounterWithFloorAtZero(a2) and v3 = 1

FontCharacterRenderDispatcher(v5, &dword_5EA5D0, a1, a2 + 20 * v3, *a1) == 1: increment v3, then SoundEventDispatcher(v5, &dword_5EA5D0, a1, a2 + 20 * v3) == 1 triggers DecrementCounterWithFloorAtZero on that slot and another increment; return the final count, else return 0
Invoked by TextOverlayDisplayTimer (004186F0) during text-overlay display
